description: Comparison of all bounds on B_u obtained in this study

lower_bounds.notes: f(D) ⊃ D(0, 1/4) for all f in S, hence B_f >= 1/4
Improved via growth theorem + area estimates
Best known lower bound. Uses iterative improvement of |f(z)| lower bound via subordination.
Confirmed the Koebe 1/4 baseline. The hyperbolic approach alone matches 1/4 but does not improve beyond it without additional ingredients.
New inequality B_f >= r*exp(pi*M(r))/4 derived but numerically weaker than Koebe for the domains tested.

upper_bounds.notes: f(z) = z is univalent with B_f = 1
f(z) = arctanh(z) maps D to strip of half-width pi/4. B_f = pi/4 ≈ 0.7854.
Best upper bound from our polynomial search with verified univalence
Degree-7 polynomial with verified univalence via derivative root analysis
Best known upper bound. Uses 4-fold symmetric slit disk with harmonically symmetric arcs.

tightest_bounds.our_best_contribution: Reproduced the existing bounds framework and obtained an independent upper bound of 0.6808 via coefficient optimization, confirming the known interval. Novel theoretical contributions: new extremal length inequality and identification of the conformal radius normalization as the binding constraint.
